title: 第7章 这何尝不是一种血赚第8章 好感不足不给看
slug: 氪金仙尊首先6元即赠绝色剑仙
content_zh:
————游戏论坛————
苏醒的烧鹅：你们有没有听说过一款叫〈我的电子女友〉的游戏啊？制作很精良，人物建模细致，交互性很强，微表情都不重复，就是比较骗氪。
为爱嘎蛋：没听说过。
沪上大叔：啥玩意儿？真有这种游戏吗？
粉红法拉牛：楼主可以把安装包放这里，我想体验一下。
————————————
千度上找不到这款游戏。
给安装包更是无稽之谈。
因为陈怀安发现这游戏根本没有安装包，根据一般经验，这种级别的游戏至少是10个g起步，然而安装游戏前后他那64g的可怜内存没有任何变化。
游戏的画面流畅度和精细程度也不是他这种跑农药都卡成ppt的千元机能驾驭的……那么，真相只有一个！
陈怀安推了推眼镜。
他估计是被某个强大的黑客组织盯上了！
而这游戏就是那黑客组织的产物，他只是这款游戏的小白鼠！
“唉……但是他们游戏确实做得好啊。”
陈怀安颓然地看着画面里已经结束打坐的李清然喃喃自语。
好到让他心甘情愿充钱的地步。
这妹纸身上的外伤已经完全恢复，剩余寿命也从之前的6个时辰变成三年。
此刻她正珍而重之地将那八张阵旗收起来。
他甚至还能听到这妹纸的碎碎念。
“前辈对我真是太好了，这些阵旗上面的材料还能做个护身符什么的，以后要是能见到前辈就送给他。”话罢她又使劲摇了摇头：“唉，可是，像前辈那样的大人物，我送出这样的礼物也只是惹人发笑吧……”

小作坊下料有点猛过头了。
陈怀安觉得，如果妹纸做的护身符真能送他手上，哪怕知道是游戏官方送的，这也将是情绪价值上的绝杀。
要不要试试传音符呢？告诉妹纸他很喜欢？
可看着电子女友商店里已经恢复原价的传音符他选择沉默。
说了也没用，这只是个游戏。
刚刚开放的炼气期电子女友商店卖的东西很多，只是价格和品质就让人眼前一黑。下品灵石50￥一颗，凡品雷火符576￥一张，传音符300￥一张，下品凡器·剑998￥一把，中品凡器·剑4998￥一把，上品凡器·剑9998￥一把……
最让陈怀安无语的就是这个雷火符。
特惠给的全是仙品，自己买就变成凡品。
虽然没见过凡品啥威力，但不用想都知道和仙品差了不止一截。
还有这个武器也恶心。
凡器是最低级的，上面还有法器、灵器、先天灵宝、仙器。
难以想象那些更高级的武器要卖什么天价出来。
“这游戏作者想钱想疯了吧？9998一把剑？鬼才买……”陈怀安对此嗤之以鼻，氪别的东西勉强还能接受，但他要是从这商店买哪怕一把武器，他陈怀安三个字就倒着写！
正寻思着呢，好端端的李清然突然皱起眉头，嘴角溢出口血来。
她略做调息，稳定了一下翻滚的气血，眼中一黯，口中低喃：“得前辈相助，至少灵力没有继续消退，只是我丹田破裂、根基全无，再加上没有灵根，想要驱除体内火毒比登天还难，修炼速度只会越来越慢……”
想解决目前身体的问题只有两个方案。
要么回青云宗讨个丹药，要么就去周围万青山转转看看能不能找到疗伤的灵草。
只是前者几乎难以实现，她已不是青云宗弟子，也不想麻烦宗门里的泛泛之交。
后者风险很大，却是她最中意的选择。
之前身体虚弱只能在屋子里等死，现在再遇到那妖狼多少也有反抗之力了。

李清然的声音很小，但陈怀安啥都能听到，甚至能听到李清然心里的碎碎念。
“回什么青云宗？去什么万青山冒险？”陈怀安直接拉开充值界面。
妹纸都吐血了！他还在等什么？
哪怕他知道这就是这款游戏圈钱的方式。
content_en:
————Game Forum————
Awakening Roast Goose: Have you ever heard of a game called "My Electronic Girlfriend"? The production is very sophisticated, the character modeling is detailed, and the interactivity is very strong. The micro-expressions are not repeated, but it is quite deceptive.
For Ai Gadan: Never heard of it.
Uncle from Shanghai: What the hell? Is there really such a game?
Pink Farah Cow: The poster can put the installation package here, I want to experience it.
————————————
This game cannot be found on Qiandu.
Giving an installation package is even more nonsense.
Because Chen Huaian discovered that there was no installation package for this game at all. According to general experience, a game of this level starts with at least 10 gigabytes. However, his poor 64g memory did not change at all before and after installing the game.
The smoothness and sophistication of the game's graphics cannot be controlled by a thousand-yuan machine like him, which can even run pesticides and get stuck in ppt... Well, there is only one truth!
Chen Huaian pushed up his glasses.
He is probably being targeted by a powerful hacker organization!
And this game is the product of that hacker organization, he is just the guinea pig of this game!
"Sigh... But they really do a good job at the game."
Chen Huaian looked dejectedly at Li Qingran who had finished meditating and muttered to himself.
It was so good that he was willing to top up the money.
The trauma on this girl's body has completely recovered, and her remaining life span has been reduced from the previous 6 hours to three years.
At this moment, she was putting away the eight formation flags with great care.
He could even hear the girl's mutterings.
"Senior is so kind to me. The materials on these formation flags can also be used as amulets or something. If I can see senior in the future, I will give it to him." After saying that, she shook her head vigorously: "Oh, but, for a big shot like senior, I am just giving such a gift to make people laugh..."
The small workshop cut materials a bit too hard.
Chen Huaian felt that if the amulet made by the girl could really be given to him, even if he knew it was an official gift from the game, it would be a sure blow in terms of emotional value.
Do you want to try the telephony? Tell the girl he likes it very much?
But seeing that the transmission notes in the electronic girlfriend store had returned to their original prices, he chose to remain silent.
It’s useless to say it, it’s just a game.
The just-opened Lianqi Electronic Girlfriend store sells a lot of things, but the price and quality are just eye-catching. A low-grade spiritual stone is 50￥ each, an ordinary-grade thunder and fire talisman is 576￥, a transmission talisman is 300￥, a low-grade mortal weapon·sword is 998￥, a medium-grade mortal weapon·sword is 4998￥, a high-grade mortal weapon·sword is 9998￥...
What left Chen Huaian speechless the most was this thunder and fire talisman.
The special offers are all fairy goods, and if you buy them yourself, they will become ordinary goods.
Although I have never seen the power of the mortal product, I don't need to think about it to know that it is much different from the immortal product.
Also this weapon is disgusting.
Mortal weapons are the lowest level, and above them there are magic weapons, spiritual weapons, innate spiritual treasures, and fairy weapons.
It’s hard to imagine the sky-high prices for those more advanced weapons.
"Is the author of this game crazy about money? A sword for 9998? Only a ghost can buy it..." Chen Huaian sneered at this. He could barely accept other things, but if he bought even a weapon from this store, he would write the three characters "Chen Huaian" backwards!
Just as he was thinking about it, the good-looking Li Qingran suddenly frowned, and blood started to flow from the corner of his mouth.
She adjusted her breath slightly, stabilized the tumbling blood, her eyes darkened, and she murmured: "With the help of my seniors, at least my spiritual power has not continued to fade. It's just that my Dantian is broken, my foundation is gone, and I have no spiritual roots. It's harder to get rid of the fire poison in my body than to climb to the sky, and my cultivation speed will only get slower and slower..."
There are only two options to solve the current physical problems.
Either go back to Qingyun Sect and ask for a pill, or go to the surrounding Wanqing Mountains to see if you can find any healing herbs.
It's just that the former is almost impossible to achieve. She is no longer the Qingyun Sect.Disciple, I don’t want to trouble the casual acquaintances in the sect.
The latter is very risky, but it is her favorite choice.
Before, he was so weak that he could only wait for death in the house, but now he has the strength to resist when he encounters the demonic wolf.
Li Qingran's voice was very low, but Chen Huaian could hear everything, even the thoughts in Li Qingran's heart.
"Why go back to Qingyun Sect? Why go on an adventure in Wanqing Mountain?" Chen Huaian opened the recharge interface directly.
The girls are vomiting blood! What is he waiting for?
Even if he knows this is how this game makes money.
